name: Dignity
overview: Scripture teaches that human dignity is rooted in being created in the image and likeness of God, as affirmed in Genesis 1:26-27, which establishes the inherent worth and authority given to mankind over creation. This divine image bestows honor and strength, exemplified in Proverbs 31:25, and is the foundation for unity in Christ that transcends ethnic, social, and gender distinctions, as stated in Galatians 3:28. Believers are called to reflect this dignity through godly character and integrity, living as patterns of good works in accordance with Titus 2:7.
